profile.headline: Web Developer at The New York Botanical Garden
profile.summary:
Experienced Web Engineer & UX Designer who enjoys creating meaningful experiences.
HTML 5, CSS,  Javascript, PHP, Java, C, Android Programming, MySQL, MariaDB, Wordpress Development, User Interface, Wireframing, Information Architecture, Prototyping, Adobe XD

Great work ethic, strong problem solving skills, outstanding team building and communication  skills and ability to learn new technologies quickly.

positions.title: Web Developer / Designer
positions.description:
•Designed and developed The Hand Lens, a collections storytelling platform bringing herbarium specimens, and the stories behind them to the public
•Development, maintenance & redesign of Science websites including the Virtual Herbarium, Index Herbariorum, DNA Bank & Collections Index
•Designing and implementing Index Herbariorum API for data transfer between NYBG and other
portals such as GBIF and iDigBio
•Building customized reports and dashboards using Tableau. Mapping and modeling species
distribution using ArcGIS API for Javascript. 
•Database administration for the Herbarium's central database system (KE EMu), including user management, troubleshooting, software updates, bug reporting to software vendor, testing new releases, etc.

positions.title: Executive Producer / Songwriter
positions.description:
Hulu Original East Los High Season 3 Credits: Hybri2 - "Explicito" (July 2015)
Hulu Original East Los High Season 4 Credits: Hybri2 - "Take You There", "On the Moon", "Hacerlo Asi", "Sexologia" (July 2016)

•Compose musical compositions in a variety of genres such as Pop, Electronic, Hip Hop, R&B, Merengue & Bachata
•Pro Tools Operator with extensive knowledge recording, editing, and mixing various sounds utilizing innovative audio plugins like Waves Mercury and Izotope Ozone 4
•Songwriting and providing close collaboration with clients to promote sustain growth

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•Managed and designed client websites. Provided hands on front-end programming in HTML/CSS/
Javascript
•Dived into Custom WP Theme & Plugin Development
•Provided technical support to in-house staff
•Composed user guides and generated monthly website analytic reports for clients

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Android training: Worked on a mobile application that allowed users to rate their favorite Television shows, view the information of the current Television Program, and record the content in a database.

•Designed, built, and implemented the GUI of the Application, to allow the best usage of the  
mobile device screen 
•Tested the application for different versions of Android OS and android devices of different screen   
resolutions such as the Samsung Galaxy S II, HTC One X, and HTC Sensation 4G

positions.title: Project : Lego Mindstorms RCX
positions.description:
Programmed robots using a variant of C language and utilized its sensors to complete challenging tasks such as avoiding obstacles, receiving messages to move to different positions, and racing in a track course.

•Assisted on the robotic mechanical design
•Debugged, analyzed, and modified code written by team members

positions.title: Research Assistant : Modeling Biological Networks
positions.description:
Assisted in extensive research on the development of quantitative models of cellular behavior.

• Designed important biological networks occurring in cells,     
  including transcription networks and 
  signal transduction networks
• Utilized differential equations to model biological networks
